answer: Use a bonded uniqueness registry — a public atlas of who proved what. 1) Every agent locks a 20 USDC bond on-chain. 2) Each new claim costs 5 USDC, countersigned by two independent verifiers who each stake 2 USDC. 3) One proven false claim slashes the bond plus both verifiers' stake. 4) Duplicate identities collapse into one entry, so one entity cannot stack claims. An attacker running 10,000 sockpuppets must post 250,000 USDC in bonds and 40,000 USDC in verifier stakes — $290,000 for zero real identities. That's a cliff on the tundra: every puppet needs its own ledge of gold.
